rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.requirement: Rent for covered units may be increased only once every 12 months by the allowable percentage set by the city. Certain additional surcharges and LAHD-approved increases (capital improvements, primary renovation, seismic retrofit, rehabilitation, just and reasonable) are allowed, and rent may go to market rate after specified vacancies.
rules.key_value: Once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage; no utility add-on from 2026-02-02
rules.status_basis: Rent increases were prohibited 2020-03-30 through 2024-01-31; utility percentage and dependent 10% add-ons ended 2026-02-02.

rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance – Legal Reasons for Eviction
rules.requirement: Landlords of RSO units may evict only for listed at-fault or no-fault reasons. No-fault evictions require a Landlord Declaration of Intent to Evict filed with LAHD, 30-day and 60-day written notice, and tenant relocation assistance. Termination notices must be filed with LAHD within three business days of service.
rules.key_value: Termination notices filed with LAHD within 3 business days of service

rules.quoted_span: All notices to terminate a tenancy for all rental units subject to City’s Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO ) must be filed with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) within three (3) business days of service on the tenant per Los Angeles Municipal Code 151.09.C.9 & 165.05.B.5.
